relations.rationale: Jun carrying a notebook of opening lines is unrelated to Finn explaining the Sicilian Defense.
Rosa being in the same class as Finn has no bearing on whether Finn brought a new set of wooden pieces.
Rosa's classmate status with Finn is unrelated to the age difference between Gia and Jun.

If Rosa is in the same class as Finn, and Finn is in the same class as Jun, that supports Rosa being in the same class as Jun (via Finn as intermediary), which is separate from claim 12 itself but claim 12 states Finn-Jun relation, not directly linked to A being about Rosa-Finn; however combined transitively it supports consistency rather than direct entailment of B.
If Rosa is in the same class as Finn, and Finn were in the same class as Jun, this would imply Rosa is in the same class as Jun, contradicting claim 15 that Rosa is not in Jun's class.
Rosa's classmate relation with Finn has nothing to do with Hugo's height.
Finn bringing a new set of wooden pieces directly enables Hugo to admire that same new set.
Finn bringing new wooden pieces is unrelated to the room's smell of chalk and old wood.
Hugo admiring the wooden pieces is unrelated to Hugo taking photographs.
Hugo's admiration of chess pieces has no connection to the age difference between Gia and Jun.
Hugo admiring the pieces is unrelated to Finn explaining the Sicilian Defense.
Hugo taking the photographs is unrelated to whether Hugo is the tallest of the group.
If Hugo took the photographs, he could not simultaneously be lined up in the yearly club photo being observed as tallest, making it less likely that his height was noted this way.
Hugo taking photographs is unrelated to Gia and Finn practicing a blitz match.
Hugo taking photographs is unrelated to the room's smell.
Gia being a year older than Jun directly supports the claim that Gia and Jun often forget this age difference while arguing.
The age difference between Gia and Jun is unrelated to Hugo learning the Sicilian Defense from Finn.
Gia and Jun forgetting their age difference while arguing is unrelated to which class Finn and Jun share.
Gia and Jun's forgetfulness about age is unrelated to when Rosa arrived.
Gia and Jun's tendency to argue about endgame theory while forgetting age differences is unrelated to Gia and Finn practicing a blitz match.
